# Pull request

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this change do and why? -->

## Change type

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — code change with no behaviour impact
- [ ] ci/chore — workflow, deps, config

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows `type: 中文描述` style.
- [ ] No third-party dependencies introduced (stdlib only).
- [ ] `index.html` is **not** committed unless its rendered output changed.
- [ ] Ran `python generate_nav.py` locally and verified the output.
- [ ] README updated if user-facing behaviour changed.
